svg.title: Distill prompt
svg.desc: Four steps: 1 paste the distill prompt into your AI agent, 2 it sorts your rules into universal, project-only and dead, 3 it sends the universal ones as lessons after you say yes, 4 it offers to overwrite your rules file with Thriae's AGENTS.md plus your project rules, and you decide.

text.font-family: Helvetica, Arial, 'Segoe UI Emoji', 'Apple Color Emoji', 'Noto Color Emoji', sans-serif
